small_guidance:
- The compile error is `tl.zeros((CHANS_PER_GROUP,))` requiring power-of-2 shape; CHANS_PER_GROUP=3 here. Round to next pow2 (e.g. `BLOCK_C = 4`) and mask `c < CHANS_PER_GROUP`, or eliminate the per-channel vector entirely.
- Also replace `tl.zeros((), ...)` scalar accumulators with `tl.zeros((1,), ...)` or plain `0.0` floats to avoid similar shape issues.
- Tune `BLOCK_S` (1024/2048/4096) with `num_warps∈{4,8}`, `num_stages∈{2,3}` via `triton.autotune`.
large_guidance:
- Redesign with a 2D tile `[BLOCK_C, BLOCK_S]` where `BLOCK_C = next_pow2(CHANS_PER_GROUP)` (constexpr) and mask the channel axis. Load the whole group×spatial tile per iteration, compute `sum`, `sum_sq` via `tl.sum` over both axes, and `per_ch_sum` via `tl.sum(axis=1)` — no manual one-hot accumulation needed.
- Fuse the conv3d into a custom Triton im2col-GEMM kernel writing directly into the GN+mean reducer (or at least into channels-last layout) so conv stops dominating; current code still calls `F.conv3d` which is the bulk of runtime.
- Skip materializing the per-channel sums by folding `mean` directly: `out = (Σ_c scale_c * sum_c + Σ_c shift_c * SPATIAL) / (OC*SPATIAL)`. Since `Σ_c shift_c * SPATIAL` is per-group constant, only `Σ_c scale_c * sum_c` needs the reduction — one program per (N, group) atomically adds into `out[n]`.
